## About
Action Air is a family-owned and operated HVAC company in Glendale. Owner and operator Mike Hall and his brother grew up in a family of entrepreneurs and self-starters, and after attending school and putting in a lot of hard work, they started their own HVAC company.
We only specialize in heating and air. As a Trane dealer, we install, repair and maintain any make and model of central air conditioning and heating systems, gas units, heat pumps, boilers and thermostats. We're driven to take care of our neighbors both near and far.
Customers rate us 5 from 484 Google reviews. Reviewers mention Mike on the phone and William, our tech, out at the house.

## Services
- Air Conditioning & Heating: Strange sound, struggling to hold a temperature, or stopped working altogether. We'll get your units running like new again.
- HVAC Repair: Heating and air repair to keep your friends, family and guests comfortable all year long.
- HVAC Replacement & Installation: We take into account the size of your home or office before recommending any new unit, then offer options suited to you.
- Pre Season Maintenance: We inspect and tighten electrical connections, clean and inspect coils, clean or replace filters, inspect blowers and fans, and check refrigerant and pressures.
- Wi-Fi Thermostats: Set a smart schedule for your system that saves energy when you're out and keeps you comfortable when you're home.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes. Give us a call or use the form on our website to request a free estimate.

Q: Do you work on my brand of system?
A: Yes. We can install, repair and maintain any make and model of central air conditioning and heating systems, for homes and businesses.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday-Friday: 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. We're closed Sunday. Give us a call for Saturday hours.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes, you can apply for financing through our website.
